title: btavdtp: Dissect A2DP configuration for Opus vendor codec
description:
The A2DP capabilities specification was based on the Android source code for Opus codec:
https://cs.android.com/android/platform/superproject/+/android-vts-15.0_r1:packages/modules/Bluetooth/system/stack/include/a2dp_vendor_opus_constants.h

This merge request also fixes spaces issue with displaying LDAC high frequencies in the listing and changes unknown values to bytes in order to display them in the listing and details screen.
